description: Passively identify a target's full technology stack — frontend framework, backend runtime, server, CMS, CDN/WAF, cloud, and versions — from public signals, then route to the right attack skills and CVEs. Load at the start of a web/API assessment, when choosing which techniques apply, or when "what is this built with / what CVEs match". Signals: a new domain in scope, unknown stack, "fingerprint", "what framework", version-to-CVE matching.
